critical_code_review_comments: routes/vp_applications.py:104 — honeypot check runs AFTER pydantic validation because it's inside the endpoint body. That is fine functionally but note: bots that just POST {website:'x'} get a 422, not a silent 200. Only bots that fill every real field AND leak the honeypot get silently ignored. Consider moving honeypot check to a request-body pre-validator if you want tighter bot blackholing.

routes/vp_applications.py:117-120 — rate limit uses ISO string comparison on created_at (`{'$gte': one_hour_ago}` where one_hour_ago is .isoformat()). Works only because all writes use the same isoformat with 'Z'-less offset. Fragile if any future writer stores a naive datetime object; consider storing an epoch ms field alongside for range queries.

routes/vp_applications.py:154 — asyncio.create_task(_send_vp_emails(doc)) fires and forgets — good, but the task is never awaited or referenced, so on server shutdown pending emails can be dropped. Acceptable for MVP; long-term move to a background queue.

AdminVPApplications.jsx:210 — after PATCH the code updates local state AND calls load(filter). The reload is fine but the local optimistic update on line 207 is now redundant (list refetch overwrites it). Minor perf-only nit.
